title: Stockholm City Hall
blurb: Ragnar Ostberg’s National Romantic city hall (1911-1923): red-brick wings around courtyards with the 106 m Stadshustornet crowned by the gilded Three Crowns, home of the Nobel Banquet.

systems.name: City Hall Tower
systems.description: The 106 m Stadshustornet: brick shaft, belfry, spire and the gilded Three Crowns.

systems.name: Main block
systems.description: The red-brick office wings around the courtyards.

systems.name: Blue Hall
systems.description: Bla hallen, the Nobel Banquet hall.

systems.name: Golden Hall
systems.description: Gyllene salen with its 18 million gold mosaic pieces.

systems.name: Council Chamber
systems.description: The chamber with its Viking longhouse ceiling.

systems.name: Borgargarden
systems.description: The citizens' courtyard with colonnades and fountain.

systems.name: Roofs
systems.description: Copper-clad roofs over the wings and halls.

systems.name: Waterfront
systems.description: The terrace and steps down to Riddarfjarden.
